verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents some automation-adjacent capabilities—embedding an agent that autonomously answers questions and completes tasks for end users, and managing flags/experiments 'from CI, scripts, or your own tools' via the Experiment APIs—but there is no dedicated documentation of an AI-native user configuring a background automation/workflow engine that runs unattended. missing for 10: explicit autonomous scheduling/trigger system, evidence of persistent background jobs configured by the user, and independent confirmation these agentic features work reliably.
